## Overview
Live tests for Birko.Data.EventSourcing.CosmosDB. They run the shared event store contract
(`tests/Shared/EventSourcing/EventStoreContract.cs`, TASK-995) on `CosmosDBEventStore`, obtained the way an application
does: `factory.GetEventStore(o => o.AddCosmosDB())`, plus the Cosmos-specific rules.

## Project Location
`tests/Birko.Data.EventSourcing.CosmosDB.Tests/`

## Test Framework
xUnit + FluentAssertions

## Scope & conventions
- Live only, gated on `BIRKO_COSMOS_CONNECTION` (`BIRKO_COSMOS_CONNECTION_MODE=Gateway` for the emulator). CI's
  `live-tests.yml` runs it on the pinned emulator.
- Each test class instance uses a database of its own (`t995<guid>`) and deletes it on dispose.
- `NewStoreAsync()` builds a new factory each call, so the concurrency tests race two clients.
- Locally, also run once with `AZURE_COSMOS_BYPASS_QUERY_PARSING=true`: CI's Linux plans queries on the gateway.

## Coverage
- `CosmosDBEventStoreContractTests`:
  - the 9 contract tests;
  - the override is chosen for a Cosmos factory;
  - a batch mixing aggregates is refused and keeps nothing;
  - a batch over the 100-operation limit is refused;
  - the container is partitioned on `/aggregateGuid`, and a document is addressed by its version within the
    aggregate's partition.
